page.overview:
Who is Margo?

Margo is a character appearing in The Power of Us. She is the daughter of Mayor Oliver.

At the beginning of the movie, Margo was playing with the wild Pokémon in the forest. But then, a rock started falling on her. Thanks to Zeraora's help Margo wasn't crushed. After that, Margo helped to heal Zeraora, then the two of them became quite good friends. When she heard that people were trying to catch Zeraora, she sabotaged the "Wind Festival" so nobody would go to the forest to try to catch it. In the end she admitted that she did the damage. Margo only wanted to keep Zeraora safe from the people of Fula City.

Then Margo and Zeraora helped save the city along with some other people.

Margo is a young girl with fair skin, short magenta hair and purple eyes
